notablePrerequisites:
Pestilence Demon has indestructible.
Sonic has indestructible.
description:
Activate Pestilence Demon by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sonic triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that is dealt damage, creating that many tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasure(s).
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
